scope: Inventory of all visible issues and PRs, including closed history. Implementation and verification have not yet been audited.
completionRule: Each actionable requirement needs implementation evidence and relevant passing validation. Closed or merged upstream state alone does not prove fork coverage. Conflicts and external dependencies require explicit disposition.
